# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Union all source tables by concatenation
Target9_51 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the 'title' column is integer type as per target schema
Target9_51['title'] = Target9_51['title'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
Target9_51.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
